caveats: The quoted words 'False. I do not miss him.' are NOT in the transcript: the fan transcript's line ends at '[serious]' and the next row is a different scene (S3E1 sc.4). Attribution to Dwight/S3E1 rests on this line being the obvious setup (only scene where Dwight says he misses Jim; the [serious] direction marks the turn) plus 'False.' being Dwight's catchphrase; the exact wording of the punchline cannot be verified here. No other scene has 'I do not miss him' with Jim. Accept 'season 3 premiere' / 'after Jim moved to Stamford' as the 'when'.
reference: Dwight says it, in the cold open of Gay Witch Hunt (S3E1), after Jim has transferred to Stamford: he fake-sobs 'Jim is gone. He's gone. I miss him so much... I cry myself to sleep, Jim!' then turns serious and denies it. The transcript records the fake-sobbing line and a [serious] direction but not the follow-up words themselves.

evidence.line: Dwight: [sobbing] Jim is gone. He's gone. I miss him so much. Ooooh I cry myself to sleep, Jim! [serious]
